name: Cypress oil
description: Cypress oil (CAS 84696-07-1 ), derived from Cupressus sempervirens, is a steam-distilled essential oil valued across fragrance, personal care, and pharmaceutical applications. Known in trade as Cypress essential oil, it delivers a fresh, woody, resinous character. This material anchors both fine fragrance compositions and functional cosmetic formulations. In perfumery and personal care, it contributes a dry, coniferous note to colognes, deodorants, and aftershave products where longevity and naturalness are priorities. Formulators incorporate it into skincare and haircare lines targeting oily or congested skin, leveraging its recognized astringent profile to support product positioning. In pharmaceutical and wellness preparations, it functions as a carrier and active component. It is frequently utilized in topical formulations, massage oils, and aromatherapy blends. Food and flavoring applications use it at controlled levels to impart a herbal, piney nuance in certain beverage and confectionery flavor systems. Cypress oil is supplied as a mobile, pale yellow to colorless liquid, typically in packaging ranging from small drums to bulk quantities suited to industrial buyers. Standard grades include natural essential oil meeting ISO specifications. Cosmetic- and pharmaceutical-grade material is available against recognized quality benchmarks such as USP , Ph.Eur. , BP , EP , and FCC standards. Buyers should confirm botanical origin and extraction method when evaluating batches. The GC/MS profile is essential for ensuring consistency across different production lots.
